verdict.rationale: LightSprint's pricing page says it can run 'in your own infrastructure or private cloud environment' (docs-30), so self-hosting is offered. This is one marketing line, apparently framed as a security/enterprise option, with no deployment documentation, licensing terms, or self-serve install path. Missing for 10: self-hosting or installation docs, clarity on which plan includes it, a self-serve deployment path for individual AI-native users, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
